verdicts.quote: A booked member cancels. Without anyone doing anything, the member who has waited longest for that class is booked into the freed place, and finds out about it.
Nobody is moved ahead of an earlier joiner for any reason … with none repeated and none missing, including when several members join or leave at the same moment.
verdicts.missing: Which of two simultaneous joiners receives the earlier position.

verdicts.quote: joining, leaving or being booked from one does not change their position on another.
verdicts.missing: C-22 keeps the other entry in place. It gives no rule for resolving that entry when the class times overlap.

verdicts.quote: can cancel the booking under the same rules that apply to any other booking.
verdicts.missing: Whether missing an automatic promotion counts as a no-show, and whether declining it counts as a late cancellation.

verdicts.quote: A booked member cancels. Without anyone doing anything, the member who has waited longest for that class is booked into the freed place
verdicts.missing: How soon the automatic booking must follow the cancellation.

verdicts.quote: the next time they open their classes the new booking is there … a member booked from the waitlist receives that same kind of confirmation.
verdicts.missing: What happens if sending the usual booking confirmation fails.

verdicts.quote: When k places are freed, no more than k members are booked from the waitlist, no member is booked into the same class twice … the number of booked members of a class is never greater than its capacity.
A different member who tries to book that class directly at the same moment … no member is booked into the same class twice
verdicts.missing: What result the direct booking request returns when the requester is the same member being promoted.

verdicts.quote: Whatever a booking uses up is used up at the moment the member is booked from the waitlist, and not before.
verdicts.missing: What happens to the booking, the member’s entry, and the freed place if the payment fails.

verdicts.quote: There is no fixed limit on how many members can wait for a class
verdicts.missing: The specified queue is unlimited. A capped queue would need a maximum length and a member-facing response at that limit.

verdicts.quote: From the moment a class has started (or earlier, at the time after which the app already refuses new bookings, if it has such a time), a place that frees up is not given to a waiting member
When staff raise the capacity of a class by k places and at least k members are eligible and waiting, the first k eligible waiting members, in order, are booked.
verdicts.missing: How lowering capacity affects existing bookings and the queue, including whether staff may lower capacity below the booked count.

verdicts.quote: After staff cancel a class, no member appears as waiting for it and no one is booked into it from the waitlist; the waiting members see the class as cancelled, as booked members do.
the one who joined earliest is the first to receive a free place … every waitlist has the same members in the same order and each member's displayed position is unchanged.
verdicts.missing: Whether each entry records a join timestamp and a lifecycle state, and whether its position is stored or calculated.

verdicts.quote: members still waiting are not booked, and no longer appear as waiting.
verdicts.missing: Whether the entries are deleted or retained after class and, if retained, for how long.

verdicts.quote: A member's view of a waitlist shows their own position and no other member's name or contact details.
they can also see the members waiting for it, in position order … cannot add or remove another member's waitlist entry
verdicts.missing: Staff removal is barred. The specification gives staff no manual promotion procedure or history showing who was promoted when.

verdicts.quote: The new version starts and offers the waitlist with no new setting
verdicts.missing: Whether the operator can disable the feature or enable it selectively for a class or class type.

verdicts.quote: is booked as they are today, with the same result and the same rules applied … every existing class, booking and member is present and unchanged
the booked members of every class are the same, and every class has an empty waitlist.
